sources.meaning: run sets dt, calls setup, then sim.run; the state object persists.
Rebuilds RunData, cell lists, interaction bindings and plugins; does not rerun UniformIC.
Loop begins at existing currentStep/currentTime; scheduler runs once per step; final cell-list rebuild can change summation order.
Intermediate density accumulation/gather precedes final forces; exactly one integration task follows force accumulation.
Executed update is v += F dt/m; x += v_new dt. No second kick in this pure-liquid call chain.
Kernel reads existing velocity and old position, applies the transform, writes xyz and preserves packed IDs.
Periodic force uses the y half-domain sign and the selected x component; parameter is force on a particle.
Setter copies xyz, preserving the fourth packed ID word, with no half-step conversion or temperature rescaling.
Getters download owned local arrays; coordinates convert local to global, velocities expose xyz only.
Shape is logical buffer size, stride[0] is C++ sizeof(T); fourth real4 component is not a physical coordinate.
Position RNG seed is compute rank + std::hash(PV name); each unit cell gets floor/ceil(n) random positions. Uniform is not a lattice.
Uniform starts at zero velocity; the frozen Python worker sets Gaussian velocities and removes COM once.
Kernel number density sums W including self; SDPD separately multiplies by particle mass for EOS.
EOS receives m*d; dissipative pair coefficient is -5*mu*(di^-2+dj^-2)*Wprime/r.
Noise amplitude is sqrt(2*5*mu*kBT/dt), multiplied once by dt in the velocity update.
Stored Mersenne Twister state advances when currentTime changes; repeated calls at the same time reuse the sample.

sources.meaning: Logistic pair hash sorts IDs in the SDPD caller, then produces intended zero-mean/unit-variance bounded arcsine noise; device variance not empirically validated here.
Stress wraps the same pair force; half contribution per ordered particle pair, not a second thermostat.
Copies density and positions at the same pre-integration phase into persistent channels.
Active saved channels follow particle redistribution/reordering. Saved positions have no shift flag, so use periodic minimum-image distances in this single periodic domain.
Owned-particle kinetic energy and momentum sampled after integration; serialized time belongs to the following step boundary.
Sums trace(stress)/3 without V or kinetic term. Stress was computed from pre-integration coordinates/velocities.

integrator_semantics: One kick followed by drift. For a conservative force it has the algebra of symplectic Euler / staggered leapfrog, but this API does not reconstruct centered integer-time velocities; velocity-dependent stochastic forces use stored pre-kick velocities.
native_bug_status: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: method semantics and finite-step bias are concerns, not proof of a native library defect.
repeated_run_status: RULED_OUT_WITHIN_TESTED_SCOPE: no time, particle state or SDPD generator reset in this no-object path. Cell-list order may change floating-point trajectories; exact continuous-vs-chunk equivalence has not been experimentally tested.
pressure_phase: Virial is pre-kick pair stress, kinetic momentum flux is post-kick; adjacent time phases differ by dt. The mean estimator is discrete-time mechanical pressure, not independently calibrated thermodynamic absolute pressure.
